title: 真机试炼：bench.html 协议（U10 / U11 / 打断×20）
handbook: §5 · 真机试炼（bench.html 协议）；B4 之后、§6 总验收之前。不做轨道 B。

searched.takeaway: U10: observe longtask after warmup. A long task is ≥50ms on the main thread. LoAF covers whole frames.

searched.q: 1% low frame time = mean of slowest 1% rAF intervals
searched.takeaway: 1% low fps = 1000 / mean(slowest 1% of intervals). Work 1% low uses tick physics+submit durations. Display rAF 1% low is informational when the compositor is locked.
U11 dual gate: downsample both crops to 32×32 luma and Pearson-correlate; also correlate luma histograms. Stipple ≠ photo; blur first. One-shot readback only.

red_lines: Do not change locked visual档 (spring, atlas, contain, CRT overlay).
Do not start Track B / Next transplant / Fusion Pixel.
Do not start §6 总验收 in this step.
Default N=12000; only ?fx=lite is the debug cap.
